page.headline: I build software factories
page.intro: I design the pipeline that turns a product request into a tested code change an engineer can review.
page.description: Andrew Hyte’s AI Platform Engineer resume: production coding agents, permissioned tool access, and software delivery.
page.title: Andrew Hyte | AI Platform Engineer

summary: I’m a Principal Enterprise AI Architect with 10+ years in software engineering. I led the production rollout of Atlas Builder for Fishbowl Inventory’s frontend repositories. It turns Jira issues into tested code changes and opens draft GitLab merge requests. Engineers retain final approval and merge authority.

highlights.title: Atlas Builder: request to review
highlights.description: Support, Product, and QA can start or clarify a fix from Slack. Atlas Builder takes the Jira issue through a test-first plan, implementation, automated tests, and independent code review.

highlights.title: Atlas Gateway: controlled tool access
highlights.description: Led the decision to build a shared gateway that gives AI agents permission to use specific tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). High-risk actions can require human approval.

highlights.title: Context Sherpa: a fix validated in preview
highlights.description: Started the toolkit behind a March 2026 fix. An agent turned a bug report into a Jira ticket, implemented the change, and opened a GitLab merge request. An independent review and QA in a preview environment preceded the merge.

roles.title: Principal Enterprise AI Architect
responsibilities: Led the production rollout of Atlas Builder across Fishbowl Inventory’s frontend repositories. Designed the workflow from issue intake to independent review and a draft merge request.
Designed resource-limited Kubernetes jobs that set up repositories and tools for each step of a run.
Shipped progress updates, structured failure details, audit events, and per-step model usage and cost tracking. Used failed runs to improve instructions, context, and verification.

Led the build-versus-buy evaluation for Atlas Gateway and secured leadership approval for an in-house platform that limits which tools agents can use and supports human approval for sensitive actions.

roles.title: Principal AI Engineer
responsibilities: Led tooling for a March 2026 AI-triaged fix, with agent code review and QA in a preview environment before merge.
Integrated Sherpa’s tools into Atlas Gateway with per-user OAuth and encrypted tokens. Packaged reusable instructions for engineering and QA.

roles.title: Software Engineering Manager
responsibilities: Started Context Sherpa to make engineering tools such as Jira and GitLab accessible to coding agents.
Led the cloud engineering team and technical roadmap, partnering with Product and Design and mentoring engineers through code reviews.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Architected a micro-frontend platform that combined React and Angular applications while preserving independent deployments.
Led the winning team in Fishbowl’s Applied AI Hackathon, building a conversational agent and MCP server in two days.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer, Frontend
responsibilities: Led five frontend engineers and weekly releases for a B2B conversational AI portal, including a no-code Canvas editor for chatbot reply flows.
Built the CI/CD pipeline with Vite, Netlify, and GitHub Actions.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Wrote the technical design and built the MVP for a B2B customer portal; developed a Lit component system and integrated customer feedback with Linear.

roles.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Integrated Router Limits technologies following acquisition and owned the Bark React Native app.

roles.title: Software Developer
responsibilities: Led frontend development; built an AngularJS progressive web app with a Node and MySQL REST API, plus Android and iOS apps using C# and Xamarin.Forms.

experience.company: Lockheed Martin Mission Systems and Training

roles.title: Software Engineer Intern
responsibilities: Contributed to training simulation software using C# .NET and WPF.

roles.title: Full Stack Programmer
responsibilities: Developed a chat application with Java Spring and an Oracle SQL backend.

skills.Agent Workflows: Multi-agent orchestration, test-first planning, Claude Code, Codex, model routing.
skills.Platform and Delivery: Kubernetes, Docker, TypeScript, Node.js, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Argo CD.
skills.Testing and Evaluation: Playwright, automated QA, independent agent review, replay, model usage and cost tracking.
skills.Tool Access and Security: MCP, FastMCP, OAuth, role-based access control (RBAC), approval gates, audit trails.

personalProject: Ran a supervised pilot in which local models implemented changes, wrote tests, and reviewed each other’s work. Used Codex for a final review. The pilot required manual recovery and did not deploy to production.
